Antes de que el año se llene, reserva en: Before the year fills up, reserve three fixed blocks on your calendar each week: one for deep work without interruptions, one to review deadlines and active files, and one to answer pending messages. Name them and treat them like a client appointment. If someone asks for that time, offer another slot; don't give it up out of habit.
Toda fecha entra al calendario el mismo: Every date goes on the calendar the same day the notice arrives. Two people calculate it separately, without seeing each other's work. If they don't match, the person responsible for the case decides, and you record who verified it.
Toda entrevista inicial debe dejar respo: Every intake must answer five things: who the person is, what immigration documents they have, whether they have an open case in court or with USCIS, whether any date is coming up and how they prefer to be contacted. Intake staff gather and record; they don't evaluate eligibility or suggest options. If an answer is missing, the intake isn't complete.
Cada contacto con tu cliente o con una a: Every contact with your client or an agency gets a note the same day. Three minimum points: what happened, what was agreed and the next step with its owner. Write as if someone else on the team had to pick up the case tomorrow without being able to call you. If the note doesn't allow that, it isn't finished.

Entrena a todo tu personal no abogado a: Train all your non-attorney staff to use the same phrase when someone asks for an opinion: “Only someone authorized to represent you can answer that question; I'll take note and pass it along today.” Explaining options, evaluating eligibility or recommending a filing is legal advice. Gathering information, scheduling and delivering documents is not. Practice the phrase out loud.
Un resumen en redes, un seminario en lín: A social media summary, a webinar or a colleague's message tells you where to look, not what the rule says. Before applying any change, open the current official source: the statute, the regulation, the policy manual or the agency's page. Note in the file which source you checked and on what date. If you can't cite it, you can't use it.
La confidencialidad se rompe más por des: Confidentiality breaks down more from carelessness than bad intent. This week, check three things: screens visible from reception, client calls in open areas and files left on desks at the end of the day. Fix one each day. Remind the team that confirming whether someone is a client is already protected information, even if a relative is asking.
Lee una decisión de la Junta en este ord: Read a Board decision in this order: first the question it resolved, then what it decided, then the reasoning and, finally, the facts that made it possible. Highlight in a different color what the Board held and what is commentary. Before citing it, verify in the official source that it's still good law and hasn't been modified or overruled.
Ningún documento sale con tu firma si no: No document goes out with your signature unless you've reviewed all of it. Have every draft come with a short cover sheet: what was prepared, which sources were used, what questions remain and what's missing. Then you review methodically, not in a rush. Professional responsibility can't be delegated; the work can, if your supervision is real and documented.
Si tu oficina usa WhatsApp, define por e: If your office uses WhatsApp, set four rules in writing: which office number is used, during what hours you respond, which topics aren't handled that way and how each relevant conversation gets into the file.
